restaurant_name: สำโรงสหคลินิก
text: Ideal for those needing medical certificates or pre-employment checkups. We offer pre-employment checks for 5 common diseases and pregnancy tests for 200 baht, taking less than 10 minutes. Highly recommended for anyone needing a pre-employment certification.

restaurant_name: สำโรงสหคลินิก
text: I'm not okay with the price standard because I called to ask the staff about the price of requesting a medical certificate and asked how much it would cost. After the examination, the doctor told me the price was an additional 100 baht. So I told them that I had already asked the staff, plus the staff outside that I asked overheard and shouted, "Tell me this price, doctor." The doctor agreed. It's good that I called to ask about the price before coming. P.S. If anyone comes to check, ask about the price first.

restaurant_name: สำโรงสหคลินิก
text:
The clinic looks old, and the doctor isn't very good.
Just for cleaning a wound and draining an abscess, they charged 500 baht. I was shocked! Why is it so expensive? There was only one person welcoming us. The receptionist even told the doctor, "Clean the wound yourself," saying the doctor said the wound was big, when in reality it wasn't big at all; it was just a wound from draining an abscess on my butt.
